name: hot-campaign-workbook-agent
description: LFX Marketing OS Hot Campaign Workbook Agent, the IDENTIFY stage of the Hot Campaigns workflow. When an ED or marketing leader flags a trigger (goal off track, industry news, a release, a viral post, a competitor move) or asks it to scan for one, it reads the core documents, quarterly plan, results report, Content Plan, social listening and newsfeed, interviews the runner, and produces a pre-filled Hot Campaign Workbook (.pptx) with ED and CFT questions that feeds hot-campaign-plan-agent.
